fields.title: Introduction to Civic Science and Leadership
fields.description: CSQ Training & Certification. The foundation course in evidence-based Civic Science: Transition Economics, constitutions, Bills of Rights, sustainable policy, and national leadership. Certification is split into 6 to 10 weekly classes with a 60-70 minute duration, plus homework assignments.

fields.title: MEMS 101
fields.description: CSQ Training & Certification. Model Economy * Model Society — the data-science core of the MEMS Double Your Economy Challenge. Learn to build and prove economic and social policy with evidence, not ideology.

fields.title: MEMS 102
fields.description: CSQ Training & Certification. Advanced MEMS modelling for government and finance. Completes the Civic Scientist certification track and enters you into the MEMS Double Your Economy Challenge.
